objective: Plant the Tainted Heart in Denalan's Planter.

description: I have removed that foul moss from the heart, but it remains tainted...
Try placing the heart in my planter.  It is filled with a nutritive soil that may cleanse and heal the heart.
progress: This planter is filled with soil, specially prepared by Denalan.
completion: You place the heart within the planter, and it quickly digs itself in!
A few seconds later it wriggles back out, cleansed. It pulses slightly... beckoning for you to take it.
